entity: Lawyer-sourced metoclopramide (Reglan) adverse-event reports in FAERS, filed through generic makers Teva, Actavis and Mutual
what_we_add: Names Teva, Actavis and Mutual as the filers; about 15,500 lawyer-sourced reports = 91% of the generic's reports; 9,089 in Apr-Sep 2011 vs about 16 a quarter in 2004-2009; median drug 0.05% lawyer-coded
why: ISMP QuarterWatch (2012) and Drugwatch name metoclopramide as 2011's most litigated drug, thousands of lawsuit-sourced FDA reports: same finding, same direction. No quote names Teva, Actavis or Mutual (read as the entity, this drops to Known pattern); RAPS's 65% of all reports through 2018 is a different base from our 91% of generic reports to 2014q2, so no contradiction.
